# SmartPlate — Smart Plate Basic

> SmartPlate is an Israeli restaurant consulting and operations technology company helping restaurant, cafe, bakery, and food-business owners improve profitability with measurable systems.

## What SmartPlate does
- Restaurant business consulting and operational consulting in Israel
- Food Cost and Labor Cost control and optimization
- Menu engineering and profitable menu pricing
- Restaurant business plans, opening support, and ROI planning
- Back-office technology for purchasing, receiving, inventory, recipes, and reporting
- AI-supported invoice scanning, supplier reconciliation, and operational automation

## Who it helps
Restaurant owners, cafe owners, bakery and pastry-business owners, bar operators, chefs, and hospitality managers looking for a restaurant consultant, restaurant business consultant, food-cost consultant, labor-cost consultant, or menu-engineering support in Israel.

## Positioning
SmartPlate combines practical restaurant-management experience with data-based analysis and Smart Plate Basic software. Its operating target is to keep Food Cost plus Labor Cost under 60% where the business model allows it.

## Service area
Israel, including Tel Aviv, Jerusalem, Haifa, Herzliya, Ra'anana, Kfar Saba, Netanya, Ramat Gan, Petah Tikva, Modi'in, Ashdod, Rehovot, and remote consulting worldwide.
